title: SSC Delhi Police HC (Ministerial) PE & MT Date 2026
vacancyDetails: Physical Endurance & Measurement Test admit card for Delhi Police Head Constable (Ministerial) Exam-2025 cycle
qualification: 10+2 / Intermediate as per Delhi Police HCM notification
ageLimit: As per Delhi Police HC Ministerial rules
applicationFee: As per SSC / Delhi Police fee rules
selectionProcess: CBT → PE & MT → Document Verification → Medical / Final selection
documentsRequired: SSC registration & DOB; PE&MT admit card printout; sports shoes/kit as instructed; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ssc.gov.in or SSC NR admit card page
2. Open Delhi Police HC (Ministerial) PE&MT/DV Admit Card
3. Login with Registration Number and DOB
4. Download call letter for PE&MT dates
5. Report at physical venue as scheduled
shortDescription: SSC Delhi Police HC (Ministerial) PE & MT Admit Card 2026 available from 21 July 2026 for physical tests around 31 July–1 August 2026.
content:
Staff Selection Commission has released the admit card for Delhi Police Head Constable (Ministerial) PE & MT / DV (Exam-2025 cycle).

Link was activated around 21 July 2026 on SSC portals. Physical tests are scheduled in late July / early August 2026 as per region notices.

Download from ssc.gov.in / SSC NR and carry original ID with hall ticket.
